title: Kin of drug war victims have ‘mixed’ emotions on Duterte’s fitness for trial — Conti
summary: The families of the drug war victims have “mixed” emotions regarding the International Criminal Court’s (ICC) decision that former President Rodrigo Duterte is fit for trial, a lawyer said on Friday.
